environment.description: Lambda invoked exclusively through an internal Application Load Balancer (ALB) in a private VPC (vpc-0a3f8e2c). The ALB has no public-facing listeners. The ALB's security group (sg-0x4f2a91be3d) allows inbound TCP/443 only from three internal CIDR blocks: 10.128.0.0/16 (production service mesh), 10.129.0.0/16 (staging service mesh), and 172.16.8.0/22 (CI/CD runners). These correspond to known internal services that already possess valid RSA-signed tokens issued by the corporate IdP. VPC has no internet gateway, no NAT gateway with public routing, and no VPC peering to any VPC with internet egress. The ALB target group health check path is /_health which bypasses auth. DNS resolution for the ALB is via Route53 private hosted zone only (not resolvable externally).
